title: QuickClock
description: Minimalistic HUD clock for better orientation
body: Clock HUD mod that places a small, unobtrusive clock item directly on your screen. It renders the vanilla Minecraft clock in the top-left corner, giving you instant time awareness without opening your inventory or relying on the sun’s position. The clock updates in real time and works in every dimension, providing a clear visual cue of day and night cycles. Designed to be fully compatible with my QuickCompass mod, both icons appear side-by-side with proper spacing, ensuring a clean and minimalistic interface with zero overlap.
